meta.maintenance: Edit this file directly; no import or build step is required.

climate.metric: Average of the daily maximum 2 m air temperature by calendar month

visas.note: Passport-specific summaries for short tourist visits; recheck before booking.

womenSafety.scale: WPS Index rescaled from 0–1 to 0–10; it combines inclusion, justice, and security.

runningInfrastructure.method: Editorial composite: roads 30%, tourist ease 25%, safety 20%, heat comfort 15%, maps and payments 10%.

gayFriendly.scale: Equaldex Equality Index (legal rights and public opinion) rescaled from 0–100 to 0–10.

meta.note: Dynamic travel, entry, and health fields must be rechecked before travel.
